parsed.name: 中央控制器
parsed.description: 这是一种用于量子实验控制系统的中央时序与数字控制设备，通常基于FPGA实现。它用于向任意波形发生器、量子测控模块等设备分发触发信号、码字和同步数字I/O信号，以协调量子比特操控与读出流程。
parsed.description_en: This is a central timing and digital control unit for quantum experiments, typically FPGA-based. It distributes triggers, codewords, and synchronized digital I/O signals to instruments such as arbitrary waveform generators and quantum readout/control modules, coordinating qubit control and readout sequences.

actions.description: 校准中央控制器与外部仪器之间的DIO数字接口协议与时序。
actions.description_en: Calibrate the DIO digital interface protocol and timing between the central controller and connected instruments.

actions.description: 输出用于DIO链路校准的测试数据模式。
actions.description_en: Output a test data pattern for DIO link calibration.
